motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no page entrance choreography.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Deliberate primary action with a visible keyboard focus outline.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--rf-accent); color: var(--rf-on-accent); border: 1px solid var(--rf-accent); border-radius: 5px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 40px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover, .ds-primary:active { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rf-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Neutral action used for refresh and cancellation.
components.css: .ds-secondary { background: var(--rf-surface); color: var(--rf-ink); border: 1px solid var(--rf-line); border-radius: 5px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 40px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover, .ds-secondary:active { background: var(--rf-raised); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rf-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: Native field with themed caret, placeholder and focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-search">Search loaded history<input placeholder="Search loaded history"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--rf-ink); font: inherit; } .ds-search input { background: var(--rf-surface); color: var(--rf-ink); border: 1px solid var(--rf-line); border-radius: 5px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 40px; font: inherit; caret-color: var(--rf-accent); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--rf-muted); } .ds-search input:hover { border-color: var(--rf-muted); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rf-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Text links with an active underline and explicit focus.
components.html: RunsStart review
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 16px; font: inherit; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--rf-muted); text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-nav a[aria-current], .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--rf-accent); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .18em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rf-focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Completed status
components.description: A text label; color is supporting information, not the only status signal.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; background: var(--rf-success-bg); color: var(--rf-success); padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font: 600 .8125rem system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The confirmed replacement is Linear-inspired: compact hierarchy, clear text, aligned controls and quiet surfaces, without copied branding. The review content carries the screen. This is a working interface, not a marketing display.
keyCharacteristics: Cool layered neutrals with a restrained blue action and focus vocabulary.
System typography with monospace reserved for code and identifiers.
Native controls and purpose-built Blazor components, without a general UI framework.
dos: Do keep focus, selection, validation, human decisions and publication distinguishable.
Do use semantic tokens for every state in both themes.
Do label uncertain data and preserve existing security and safe HTTP boundaries.
donts: Don't add decorative metric cards, remote fonts or a replacement component framework.
Don't store credentials, findings, reasons or selections in browser persistence.
Don't treat bUnit/JS tests as proof of real-browser contrast, focus, reflow or first-paint behavior.
